# The harmonic oscillator (claims)

Literature claims overlapping `Physlib.ClassicalMechanics.HarmonicOscillator.Basic`.

claims.name: harmonicOscillator_energyConserved
claims.statement: The total mechanical energy of an undamped harmonic oscillator is conserved along trajectories.

claims.name: harmonicOscillator_period
claims.statement: The period $T = 2\pi\sqrt{m/k}$ is independent of amplitude.
